ranked_evidence.title: Active Covid cases in country decline to 1,31,807 - Rediff.com India News
ranked_evidence.snippet: Home  » News » Active Covid cases decline to 1,31,807 with 12,751 new infections. # Active Covid cases decline to 1,31,807 with 12,751 new infections. With 12,751 new coronavirus infections being reported in a day, India's tally of COVID-19 cases rose to 4,41,74,650, while the active cases have declined to 1,31,807, according to the Union health ministry data updated on Tuesday. The active cases comprise 0.30 per cent of the total infections, while the national COVID-19 recovery rate was recorded at 98.51 per cent, the ministry said. A decrease of 3,703 cases has been recorded in the active COVID-19 caseload in a span of 24 hours. The number of people who have recuperated from the disease surged to 4,35,16,071, while the case fatality rate was recorded at 1.19 per cent. India's COVID-19 tally had crossed the 20-lakh mark on August 7, 2020, 30 lakh on August 23, 40 lakh on September 5 and 50 lakh on September 16.

ranked_evidence.title: Active COVID-19 cases at over 300; Health Officials encourage use of face masks and vaccine booster shots - News Source Guyana
ranked_evidence.snippet: ## “We have nothing to hide” -says PM Mark Phillips on MV Barima ferry tragedy. By News Source Guyana on January 4, 2023. With over 300 active cases of COVID-19 in the country, the Ministry of Health is encouraging persons who are still not vaccinated to get vaccinated and those who are fully vaccinated are being encouraged to get a booster dose. The Ministry of Health has indicated that it has vaccines available across the country and persons should still safeguard themselves against COVID-19 cases. The number of new COVID-19 cases has seen an increase in the past three weeks and the Health Ministry has also reported three additional deaths in the past week. Health officials have been paying close attention to the increase in new cases and are bracing themselves for any additional increase following the holiday season. While face masks are no longer a requirement, persons are still being encouraged to safeguard themselves by using face masks when in large crowd settings or out in the public.

ranked_evidence.title: Coronavirus: Is the epidemic finally coming to an end in India?
ranked_evidence.snippet: # Coronavirus: Is the epidemic finally coming to an end in India? Reuters A man walks past a graffiti of a girl wearing a protective mask amidst the spread of the coronavirus disease (COVID-19) on a street in Navi Mumbai, India January 21, 2021.Reuters. Case numbers and deaths have been swiftly dropping in India. **Is the sharp drop in India's coronavirus cases as** dramatic **and** curious **as some believe?**. Is the epidemic firmly in retreat in a country where many early modellers had predicted millions of deaths due to Covid-19? Cases had hit a record peak in the middle of September - there were more than a million active cases. So far, India has recorded more than 10 million infections - the second-highest in the world after the US. It is also clear that the decline in cases is not because of lower testing. Also, it has seen a high proportion of cases and deaths of people above the age of 65 living in densely packed cities, hewing to infection trends around the world.

ranked_evidence.title: REMUS 300 Unmanned Underwater Vehicle (UUV), USA - Naval Technology
ranked_evidence.snippet: # REMUS 300 Unmanned Underwater Vehicle (UUV), USA The REMUS 300 is a two-man portable, small-class unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV). The REMUS 300 UUV can perform a range of missions including mine countermeasures, hydrographic survey and rapid environmental assessment. The REMUS 300 is a small-class unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV) built for military and commercial applications. Hydroid sold more than 500 REMUS UUVs to 25 countries. ## REMUS 300 UUV design and features It incorporates design improvements from the REMUS 100 autonomous underwater vehicle. The REMUS 300 retains the already trusted REMUS 100’s hull design with improvements which will enable the vehicle to dive to a maximum depth of 305m (1,000ft). HII received an order from the US Navy to supply two REMUS 300 UUVs in May 2021.

SIMPSONVILLE SC, February 19, 2026, Feb. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Dodge Industrial, Inc., a leading provider of innovative industrial solutions, is proud to announce the launch of its new 300-Series mounted ball bearing. "Launching the 300-Series mounted ball bearing marks a significant milestone for Dodge Industrial," said Josh Tanrikulu, Global Product Manager for Mounted Ball Bearings.
